headline: Openidea recreates an IntelliJ-style IDE in Rust
body: Built in Rust, this fast app features IntelliJ-style keymaps, tool windows, and search. It includes an editor, debugger, Git, terminal, database, and HTTP tools for 60+ languages.

Openidea recreates an IntelliJ-style IDE in Rust

Built in Rust, this fast app features IntelliJ-style keymaps, tool windows, and search. It includes an editor, debugger, Git, terminal, database, and HTTP tools for 60+ languages.
